Let's do some figure drawin

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
library(knitr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

## Load data

```{r}
# Combined data
combined <- read.csv("../Cross_compare/NPP_AMF_combined.csv")

# need to remove the fourth row bc I'm missing data (the bnpp)
combined <- combined[-4,]

combined <- combined %>%
  mutate(
    Inoculation = factor(Inoculation),
    Polyculture = factor(Polyculture),
    Group = interaction(Inoculation, Polyculture, sep = "_")
  )

# Speciality subsetted ones
mono_only <- combined[combined$Polyculture != "Inter", ]

inter_only <- combined[combined$Polyculture != "Mono", ]

```

### NPP vs Berry productivity

Water as continuous! Can be changed for categorical if desired
```{r}
# NPP
ggplot(mono_only, aes(x = Water_gal, y = NPP_g_pp, color = Inoculation, group = Inoculation)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point") +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line") +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.2) +
  labs(title = "Mono Only: Water:Inoculation Interaction Impacts on system NPP", x = "", y = "NPP")

# reproduction
ggplot(mono_only, aes(x = Water_gal, y = Berries_g_pp, color = Inoculation, group = Inoculation)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point") +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line") +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.2) +
  labs(title = "Mono Only: Water:Inoculation Interaction Impacts on Berry Productivity", x = "", y = "Berry productivity (g)")

## NOW COMBINED

# make long dataframe with both response variables
mono_long <- mono_only %>%
  select(Water_gal, Water, Inoculation, Berries_g_pp, NPP_g_pp) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Berries_g_pp, NPP_g_pp),
    names_to = "Response",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Response = case_when(
      Response == "NPP_g_pp" ~ "Total Biomass",
      Response == "Berries_g_pp" ~ "Yield"
    )
  )

# faceted plot
ggplot(mono_long, aes(x = Water, y = Value, color = Inoculation, group = Inoculation)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 2.5) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", linewidth = 0.9) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.15) +
  facet_wrap(~Response, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Interacting Effects of Drought and AMF Inoculation",
    x = "Water treatment",
    y = "Grams biomass per plant",
    color = "Inoculation"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

inoc_ppt_interact.png <- ggplot(mono_long, aes(x = Water, y = Value, color = Inoculation, group = Inoculation)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", linewidth = 1.2) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 3.5) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.12, linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~Response, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#3B6C8E", "#C2A46D")) +
  labs(
    title = "Interacting Effects of Precipitation and AMF Inoculation",
    x = "Drought treatment",
    y = "Biomass (g per plant)",
    color = "Inoculation"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 18),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#EAF1F5", color = NA),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing = unit(1.2, "lines"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

ggsave("PresentationFigs/inoc_ppt_interact.png", plot = inoc_ppt_interact.png, width = 9, height = 4.8, dpi = 300)

```

### Allocation to berries
```{r}
ggplot(mono_only, aes(x = Water, y = percent_berries_of_wheat, color = Inoculation, group = Inoculation)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point") +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line") +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.2) +
  labs(title = "How inoculation affects reproductive allocation during drought", x = "", y = "Percent reproductive allocation") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```


### Allocation to various parts

```{r}
mono_alloc_long <- mono_only %>%
  select(Water, Water_gal, Inoculation,
         percent_berries_of_wheat,
         percent_ANPP_of_wheat,
         percent_BNPP_of_wheat) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(percent_berries_of_wheat,
             percent_ANPP_of_wheat,
             percent_BNPP_of_wheat),
    names_to = "Response",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Response = case_when(
      Response == "percent_berries_of_wheat" ~ "Berries",
      Response == "percent_ANPP_of_wheat" ~ "ANPP",
      Response == "percent_BNPP_of_wheat" ~ "BNPP"
    )
  )

# Categorical
ggplot(mono_alloc_long,
       aes(x = Water, y = Value, color = Inoculation, group = Inoculation)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 2.5) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", linewidth = 0.9) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.15) +
  facet_wrap(~Response) +
  labs(
    title = "Impacts of Precipitation and Inoculation on Biomass Allocation",
    x = "Precipitation Treatment",
    y = "Percent allocation",
    color = "Inoculation"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )


# colors
mono_alloc_long <- mono_only %>%
  select(
    Water, Water_gal, Inoculation,
    percent_berries_of_wheat,
    percent_ANPP_of_wheat,
    percent_BNPP_of_wheat
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      percent_berries_of_wheat,
      percent_ANPP_of_wheat,
      percent_BNPP_of_wheat
    ),
    names_to = "Response",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Response = case_when(
      Response == "percent_berries_of_wheat" ~ "Yield",
      Response == "percent_ANPP_of_wheat" ~ "Aboveground Biomass",
      Response == "percent_BNPP_of_wheat" ~ "Belowground Biomass"
    ),
    Water = factor(Water, levels = c("Control", "Moderate", "Severe"))
  )

resource_allocation.png <- ggplot(
  mono_alloc_long,
  aes(x = Water, y = Value, color = Inoculation, group = Inoculation)
) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line", linewidth = 1.2) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 3.5) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.12, linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~Response) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#3B6C8E", "#C2A46D")) +
  labs(
    title = "Impacts of Precipitation and Inoculation on Resource Allocation",
    x = "Drought treatment",
    y = "Percent allocation",
    color = "Inoculation"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#EAF1F5", color = NA),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing = unit(1.2, "lines"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

ggsave("PresentationFigs/resource_allocation.png", plot = resource_allocation.png, width = 9, height = 4.8, dpi = 300)

```
### Hyphal colonization

```{r}

# Just severe water Berries, for example
ggplot(filter(mono_only, Water == "Severe"),
       aes(x = hyphal_colonization, y = percent_berries_of_wheat)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  labs(
    x = "Hyphal colonization (%)",
    y = "Berry allocation (%)",
    title = "AMF colonization & berry allocation (Severe only)"
  )

# the faceted figures

## HYPHAL

hyphal_mono_berries <- mono_only %>%
  filter(Water %in% c("Control", "Severe")) %>%
  select(hyphal_colonization, Water, percent_berries_of_wheat, NPP_g_pp) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(percent_berries_of_wheat, NPP_g_pp),
    names_to = "Response",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Water = factor(Water, levels = c("Control", "Severe")),
    Response = factor(
      Response,
      levels = c("percent_berries_of_wheat", "NPP_g_pp"),
      labels = c("Allocation to Yield (%)", "Total Biomass (g per plant)")
    )
  )

ggplot(hyphal_mono_berries, aes(x = hyphal_colonization, y = Value)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  facet_grid(Response ~ Water, scales = "free_y", drop = TRUE) +
  labs(
    x = "Hyphal colonization (%)",
    y = NULL,
    title = "AMF Hyphal colonization relationships with berry allocation and NPP"
  ) +
  theme_bw()


## ARB VESC

arbvesc_mono_berries <- mono_only %>%
  filter(Water %in% c("Control", "Severe")) %>%
  select(hyphal_colonization, Water, arb_vesc_colonization, NPP_g_pp) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(arb_vesc_colonization, NPP_g_pp),
    names_to = "Response",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Water = factor(Water, levels = c("Control", "Severe")),
    Response = factor(
      Response,
      levels = c("arb_vesc_colonization", "NPP_g_pp"),
      labels = c("Reproductive allocation (%)", "NPP (g per plant)")
    )
  )

ggplot(hyphal_mono_berries, aes(x = hyphal_colonization, y = Value)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  facet_grid(Response ~ Water, scales = "free_y", drop = TRUE) +
  labs(
    x = "Hyphal colonization (%)",
    y = NULL,
    title = "AMF Hyphal colonization relationships with berry allocation and NPP"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

ggplot(arbvesc_mono_berries, aes(x = hyphal_colonization, y = Value)) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  facet_grid(Response ~ Water, scales = "free_y", drop = TRUE) +
  labs(
    x = "Arbuscular Vesicular colonization (%)",
    y = NULL,
    title = "AMF Arbuscular Vesicular colonization relationships with berry allocation and NPP"
  ) +
  theme_bw()


```

# Water impacts on AMF colonization

```{r}
root_hyphal_drought.png <- ggplot(mono_only, aes(x = Water, y = hyphal_colonization)) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "bar",
    fill = "#3B6C8E",
    color = "black",
    alpha = 0.85,
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    fun.data = mean_se,
    geom = "errorbar",
    width = 0.2,
    linewidth = 0.9,
    color = "black"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Impact of Precipitation on AMF Hyphal Colonization",
    x = "",
    y = "Root hyphal colonization (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 18),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )

ggsave("PresentationFigs/root_hyphal_drought.png", plot = root_hyphal_drought.png, width = 9, height = 4.8, dpi = 300)

```


# Fava as mitgator?

```{r}
# Berry allocation
fava_berry_allocation.png <- ggplot(
  combined,
  aes(
    x = Water,
    y = percent_berries_of_wheat,
    color = Inoculation,
    shape = Polyculture,
    linetype = Polyculture,
    group = interaction(Inoculation, Polyculture)
  )
) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "line",
    linewidth = 1.1,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.15)
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    size = 3,
    alpha = 0.9,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.15)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Inoc" = "#3B6C8E", "Strl" = "#C2A46D")) +
  labs(
    title = "Fava Intercropping May Ameliorate Decline in Yield \n Allocation Incurred by Inoculation During Drought",
    x = "",
    y = "Allocation to Yield (%)",
    color = "Inoculation",
    shape = "Polyculture",
    linetype = "Polyculture"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 15) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 17),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )

ggsave("PresentationFigs/fava_berry_allocation.png", plot = fava_berry_allocation.png, width = 9, height = 4.8, dpi = 300)
```
